**Breaking**: a repo's waivers file is now
with its history and follows the project's mentions of it. If both

Session start asks one question for every update waiting (the ion-repo tool, the
other Ion tools, the repo) instead of up to three.
writes and sharpens an Ion tool's skill, without starting a session
unless you ask for its eval loop.
writes its prompts to a temp file and
gives a Claude Code session's prompt as the command that opens it.
The Ion logo in flight replaces the stone kiln in the banner, the session-start
. kiln's folders move at the first read, and
previews a whole sample session without wrapping, and one-hue
palettes are brightest when urgent; an ion-repo installed from its checkout
reinstalls itself when its dependencies lag.
